source: Trader-provided FVG transcript, prior trade screenshots/master rulebook, frozen 14-case replay, and explicit trader clarifications through 2026-08-20

detector_authority.rule: Use the existing native detector; do not maintain a second strategy-specific FVG detector.

fvg_identity.bullish: third candle low is strictly above first candle high
fvg_identity.bearish: third candle high is strictly below first candle low
fvg_identity.zone_boundaries: wick-to-wick price band between candle one and candle three
fvg_identity.active_gap: formed and not subsequently re-entered/mitigated on a completed later 15m bar

trader_target_rule.purpose: FVG is one possible take-profit reaction destination and may also be a causal support/resistance interaction band; it is never an automatic trade.
trader_target_rule.fvg_take_profit: middle of the selected active 15m FVG, tick rounded conservatively
trader_target_rule.fvg_edge_reaction_boundary: The trader may use the relevant end/edge of the FVG as the support/resistance reaction boundary when that FVG is the physical structure immediately before the next key level.
trader_target_rule.liquidity_cluster_take_profit: safe middle/interior of the selected meaningful liquidity cluster
trader_target_rule.normal_tp1_rule: The first meaningful physical reaction that still has the frozen minimum room at the actual entry clock owns TP1.
trader_target_rule.tp1_to_tp2_rollover: If price has already moved so close to TP1 before the A+ entry becomes actionable that TP1 is inside Params.min_room_r * Params.stop, TP1 is a consumed/too-late destination for that entry plan and the next meaningful physical reaction may become TP2.
trader_target_rule.rollover_threshold: reuse Params.min_room_r * Params.stop; no new numeric threshold
trader_target_rule.target_only_15m_zone_rule: An active established 15m zone with at least 2 independent rejections and quality>=min_zone_quality remains a meaningful TP/blocker even when it lacks the confluence or high_zone_quality required to authorize a fresh entry.

fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bearish_from_resistance_fvg: price must reject the FVG resistance band and then prove bearish candle story plus sustained bearish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bullish_through_resistance_fvg: price must disrespect/clear the opposing FVG resistance band under the normal breakout confirmation plus sustained bullish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bullish_from_support_fvg: price must reject the FVG support band and then prove bullish candle story plus sustained bullish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bearish_through_support_fvg: price must disrespect/clear the opposing FVG support band under the normal breakout confirmation plus sustained bearish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.intraday_fvg_refresh: Only completed active 15m FVGs known at the start of each forming 5m bucket may participate; future/incomplete 15m FVGs are forbidden.

video_entry_filters.adoption_rule: Do not silently import unrelated creator checklist thresholds. Only the trader-confirmed current-strategy FVG identity, TP role, support/resistance interaction, rejection/clearance behavior and causal timing are executable authority.
